repos_data.description: By MiN8T — email infrastructure, design, and deliverability platform. Open-source SDKs + MCP server for DeliverIQ + the MiN8T editor.
MCP server for IntoDNS.ai — free DNS, DMARC, SPF, DKIM, BIMI, MTA-STS, DNSSEC & email security checks for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and other AI agents. No API key required.
MCP server for ZeroDrop — gives AI agents disposable inboxes with auto-extracted OTPs and magic links. Claude, Cursor, Claude Code.
MCP server for email compatibility analysis: preview, audit, fix, diff, and check deliverability across 21 email clients.
MCP server for Apple Mail: sub-ms search over 300k+ messages via Mail's own SQLite index, verified sends, Exchange body backfill, triage plan/review/apply. 849 tests, MIT.
The most complete MCP server for the Resend email API — full API coverage plus a unique debug/diagnostics layer.
MCP server for MultiMail — Verifiable identity email for AI agents
MCP server for Outlook email, calendar, and contacts — let your AI assistant manage your inbox directly from the conversation.

Coldrig — cold email infrastructure run entirely by your coding agent (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Cline). One token, 28 intent-level MCP + HTTP tools and an npm CLI: domain purchase, mailboxes, warmup, sequences, replies, deliverability guardrails. Free fault-injecting sandbox.
MCP server for the Mamba Labs Domain Deliverability Checker actor: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, blacklist, catch-all, domain age. Clay-ready.
Domain security reconnaissance MCP server — 13 tools for AI agents. Free, no API key.
MCP server for the PostStack Email API — 84 tools, 5 prompts, 5 resources for AI agents.

repo_meta_data.description: MCP server for email deliverability testing across 9 providers. Test inbox placement (Inbox vs Spam vs Promotions) with SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf.
